messages.subject: [Reiterating] Customizing lastpage in mirtCAT (editing the server part of shinyapp)
parts:
Hi Phill and mirtCAT group,
I'm reiterating this question in case you missed my previous thread.

I have been using createShinyGUI() with the lastpage simply customized.
Recently I happened to require the last page to provide more advanced features (e.g. action buttons that generate some pop up messages) after user takes an adaptive test.
I was able to generate the ui for this kind of button by editing a GUI element(lastpage) but couldn't make this button functional.
My understanding is that I need to specify something like 'ObserveEvent {}' somewhere in the server side of the shinyapp, but I don't know where I can add this when using mirtCAT_premable() and createShinyGUI. I tried to put it directly to lastpage but it failed.

To be specific, when I look into the 'createShinyGUI()' function, it returns
"return(shinyApp(ui = ui(), server = server))"

I want to know where 'server' object is specified and whether I can edit that. I only need to put additional 'observeEvent{}' script in the server object so it would be also helpful if there is any way to do that without finding an entire script.

Thanks,
Jungmin
